method.adaptive_production: 110% of the prior round units sold
method.decision_policy: all non-subject teams retain the competent baseline
method.design: deterministic seeded, full-horizon, 8-profile field; one-factor-at-a-time sweeps plus a disclosed composed policy applied to the weakest baseline profile
limitations: The engine is deterministic; seeded repeats establish repeatability but do not provide stochastic confidence intervals.
One-factor sweeps describe local policy paths, not every interaction in the combinatorial decision space.
The composed skilled policy is selected in-sample on team 0 and is tested once on the weakest profile; it is not a holdout-trained optimizer.
The replay writes locked decisions directly, as the pre-existing calibration harness does; results measure resolution mechanics, not API usability.
Debt/equity evidence varies legal-sized debt and repayment flows; it does not force surplus equity issuance when no funding shortfall exists.

adversarial_profile_test.selection_rule: per family, compose the level with the highest team-0 final PI only when it improves baseline by more than 0.01; ties use income then cash
